text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (Pseudotumor Cerebri). Given the normal blood work, inflammatory markers, and MRI findings showing increased intracranial pressure without masses, and your history of worsening morning headaches with visual disturbances, this diagnosis is confirmed. I recommend starting acetazolamide and referring you to neurology for an urgent lumbar puncture to measure opening pressure.
